notes.classification: IRCAM basic/extended membership from the 'IRCAM Neo-Tifinagh alphabet' and 'IRCAM extended Tifinagh letters' tables in en.wikipedia 'Tifinagh' (which cite Andries 2004, Unicode WG2 N2739). Tuareg usage from the 'Tuareg scripts' table in the same article (Aghali-Zakara 1993, quoted in Andries 2004 and Casajus 2011). Unicode names from UCD NamesList.txt.
notes.libyco_berber: The ancient Libyco-Berber script (inscriptions from roughly the Numidian/Mauretanian kingdoms era, 202–25 BCE per the article; eastern form Constantine/Aurès/Tunisia, 22 of 24 letters deciphered via Punic–Libyc bilinguals; western form undeciphered) has NO Unicode encoding and NO glyphs here. None of these PNGs should be presented as ancient Libyco-Berber letters. Neo-Tifinagh derives (via Saharan and Tuareg Tifinagh) from that tradition; letter-by-letter ancient equivalences are not asserted.
notes.omitted: U+2D7F TIFINAGH CONSONANT JOINER (not visibly rendered).
